title: TCP: Zero Window Probe ACK detection for improper clients
description:
When a Zero Window Probe is effectively consumed by the receiver,
the analysis should indeed take that into account. Similarly, when
the Receive Window is immediately re-opened without going through
a Zero Window Probe ACK, it should be marked adequately.

Fixes #10745. See #8404
